headings.characteristics: Bold, editorial, premium sans-serif. Used for H1, H2, H3.
headings.styles: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight to tracking-tighter) for large headlines. Mix font-light with font-bold for tension. Use italics selectively for emphasis.

body.characteristics: Clean, minimal, highly readable modern geometric sans.
body.styles: Warm off-white text, leading-relaxed for body content. Large editorial scales.

forbidden: Pure transparent without blur over content

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain/noise texture overlay across the entire site to prevent digital flatness. Use a mix-blend-mode overlay.
visual_enhancers.gradients: Very subtle, massive radial gold gradients in the background (blur-3xl, opacity-10) to create depth without overwhelming.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY where appropriate (e.g., sticky navbar, video play button overlay, certain floating cards). Requires heavy blur (backdrop-blur-xl), slight saturation boost, and a 1px subtle inner border.
visual_enhancers.borders: Thin borders (1px border-white/5 or border-gold/10) for elegant cards.
visual_enhancers.glow: Soft gold glow effects behind primary CTAs or highlight text, but kept extremely subtle.

components_strategy.hero_section: Layered editorial layout. Must include main headline 'Your Content System. Done For You.', a '50M+ views' credibility stat, '15+ clients', and a prominent 'RESULTS FIRST' guarantee card.
components_strategy.guarantee_card: A standout card in the hero or slightly below. High contrast (subtle gold border), stating: 'RESULTS FIRST. If you don't get results, you don't need to pay.'
components_strategy.capabilities_list: A minimalist, elegant list with custom gold icons or checkmarks, showing the DFY content system features.
components_strategy.video_cards: 4 vertical 9:16 cards. Elegant rounded corners (rounded-2xl or 3xl), dark premium base, gold/cream accents. Play button overlay (glassmorphism). Smooth hover effect (slight lift and glow).
components_strategy.social_proof_cards: Client Instagram handles presented as elegant, minimal social-proof cards (e.g., with an @ symbol and a verified check, subtle dark glass), NOT a basic bullet list.
components_strategy.navigation: Fixed premium nav (z-50) with glassmorphism, Home/Work/Contact links, right-aligned CTA, mobile hamburger menu.
components_strategy.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded rectangles. Primary CTA uses gold accent (bg-gold, text-black) with subtle hover glow. WhatsApp & Instagram styled minimally but clearly identifiable.
components_strategy.scroll_indicator: A fixed subtle gold line at the top or side indicating scroll progress.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use massive padding (py-24, py-32) between sections. Breathing room is critical for the 'expensive' feel.
grids_and_layouts.grid_system: Bento grids for hero/stats. 4-column grid for the video reels on desktop, cascading or scrolling on mobile. Asymmetry is welcome.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text and capabilities. Headings can be centered if balanced visually. Mobile-first responsive.

motion.philosophy: Smooth, professional, fast. NO flashy/bouncy effects.
motion.interactions: Micro-animations: slight card movement on hover (-translate-y-1, subtle gold shadow), soft gold glow on buttons.
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling using Framer Motion. Subtle text reveal (opacity and y-axis shift) as elements enter viewport.
motion.transitions: Smooth cross-fade or subtle slide for section transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gold/dark backgrounds passes APCA/WCAG. Use text-shadow if needed.
accessibility.focus: Custom focus rings (gold) for keyboard navigation.
accessibility.aria: Add data-testid to all interactive elements.

media.images: NO stock photos. NO fake testimonials/logos. Minimal visual clutter. Real videos provided for 9:16 reels.
media.videos: Use <video> elements with autoPlay=false, loop, muted, playsInline. Cover with a custom thumbnail or dark overlay until hovered/clicked. Apply object-cover so they fill the 9:16 container perfectly.

3d_libraries: None required. Rely entirely on pristine typography, lighting, glassmorphism, and Framer Motion for premium feel.

image_urls.description: Using vertical (9:16) cinematic placeholder videos since real videos are requested but not provided in the environment. These fit the premium, moody aesthetic perfectly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a 3-section single-page portfolio (Hero, Work, Contact) with a fixed 100vh height per section if possible, or naturally scrolling full-screen sections.
Use standard React + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion (for animations).
Ensure the layout is completely mobile-first and responsive. On mobile, the 4 vertical videos should probably be a horizontal scroll snap or a 2x2 grid.
Apply a subtle grain/noise overlay to the entire body to give a tactile, premium feel (e.g., an SVG noise background fixed with opacity-5).
Implement the 'RESULTS FIRST' card prominently in the Hero section.
Implement a scroll progress indicator (fixed top or right edge, height/width driven by useScroll).
Implement the WhatsApp and Instagram CTAs in the final Contact slide, styled elegantly.
Include a mobile hamburger menu for the fixed nav. Do NOT use completely transparent background for the mobile menu overlay.
Build custom Tailwind divs for bento and video cards; do not constrain yourself with Shadcn if it limits layout.
Use 'mixkit' vertical videos provided in `image_urls` as the sources for the 4 video reels. Add a glassmorphic play button overlay.
The client Instagram handles should be designed as elegant social-proof cards (e.g., '@handle • 1M+ Views'), placed either in the Hero or alongside the Work section.
NO pricing, NO stock photos (other than the placeholder cinematic videos).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
